## The current live classifier on the same test incidents

- Test incidents: 53; macro-F1 over the test classes: **0.0**; abstained: 53.
- Predicted labels: {'unknown': 53}.
- Test classes it cannot name at all: ['cpu_runaway', 'network_delay'].
- Columns passed (same meaning): ['cpu_ratio', 'cpu_z', 'error_ratio', 'error_ratio_delta', 'lat_ratio', 'lat_z', 'mem_slope_share_per_min', 'rps_ratio', 'rps_z', 'up_frac']. Live features left unobserved: ['cpu_per_req_ratio', 'cpu_per_req_z', 'dep_fail_rate', 'deploys_3m', 'error_log_rate', 'error_ratio_z', 'mem_rel_growth', 'restarts_in_window', 'scratch_mb', 'scratch_slope_mb_per_min'].
- **Not a fair comparison**: the live model was trained on another schema (10 s live windows of one app) and most of its inputs are missing here. It is reported because the plan asks for both on the same held-out data, not as evidence that either model is better.

## Plan statements compared with this run
- Plan §18: 'fault classifier ... 33% (12-59%) on never-seen systems'; §20: '58% on Train Ticket'. This run, real rows only: macro-F1 0.385 (variant P) and 0.449 (variant L) on Train Ticket. Different training data from the plan's v2 (no synthetic rows), so the numbers are not directly comparable.
- Plan §18: 'unknown-fault AUROC ~0.66'. Not computed here (no AUROC rule was fixed in advance); the flagged share at the validation threshold is reported instead.
